title: Quick-Drying Sports Shorts – Breathable
descriptionHtml:
Comfortable shorts that keep you cool

Cotton shorts get heavy and clammy with sweat during workouts and hot days. It feels uncomfortable and takes a long time to dry.

Light and breathable fabric

These sports shorts are made of light, breathable fabric that dries quickly. The stretchy material gives freedom of movement both on your run and on the beach.

Features

  • Quick-drying and breathable fabric
  • Stretchy material for full freedom of movement
  • Comfortable for workouts and everyday wear
  • Double layer for a good fit
  • Great for running, the gym and outdoor life

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
